name: shehirian-modular
description: Modular multilingual static site for Shehirian Family

scripts.//build: Deliberately skips sync-google-sheets.js — fast local iteration, and avoids silently overwriting local ui-strings.json with whatever's currently in the live Sheet (which may be mid-edit or bad). netlify.toml's [build].command includes the sync; production must reflect the Sheet. Use build:full to test the exact production pipeline locally.
scripts.build:full: npm run build:recipes && node sync-google-sheets.js && node generate-index.js
scripts.//dev:auth-stub: Local-only: full stack (real functions + real DB) with a stubbed Netlify Identity, since there's no real Identity backend to validate a JWT against locally. Never deployed — see scripts/dev-server.js and LOCAL_DEV.md. Run `npm run build` first. Default stub identity has both translator and approver roles — use the :translator / :approver variants to test either role in isolation.
scripts.dev:auth-stub:translator: cross-env STUB_ROLE=translator netlify dev:exec node scripts/dev-server.js
scripts.dev:auth-stub:approver: cross-env STUB_ROLE=approver netlify dev:exec node scripts/dev-server.js
scripts.//db:clean-test-edits: Deletes ONLY rows in `edits` whose editor_email matches the auth-stub's fake identity (scripts/stub-identity.js) — never touches edit_log (append-only by design). Safe to run repeatedly after local dev:auth-stub sessions. See LOCAL_DEV.md.
scripts.//test:phase4: Phase 4 recipe-admin behavioral matrix, run against a locally running dev:auth-stub* server (start that separately first). Wraps netlify dev:exec so the DB-seeding helpers get DATABASE_URL directly. See tests/phase4/ and TESTING.md.
scripts.//test:phase5:unit: Pure-function tests for the approve action's conflict guard, apply-to-JSON transform, and idempotency check — no DB, no GitHub, no server needed. See tests/phase5/approveLogic.test.js.
scripts.//test:phase5:integration: Exercises the REAL recipes-approve.js handler and a REAL GitHub commit, but against test/phase5-scratch (never translation-pipeline) -- Netlify only builds translation-pipeline, so this triggers no deploy. Needs DATABASE_URL and GITHUB_TOKEN, hence netlify dev:exec. See TESTING.md and LOCAL_DEV.md.

author: Shehirian Family
